origin.57.en: Two days after start: The Nature of the Alliance (choose the federation type)

opening.evidence: events/game_start.txt:315 fires hidden origin.55 (events/origin_events_1.txt:1442-1998: creates two federation partners, sets intel and borders). The branch `has_origin = origin_common_ground` (:1862-1933) sets the federation leader and fires origin.57 after 2 days; the Hegemon branch (:1935-1996) sets hegemony_federation directly and has no window.

notes.zh: 该窗口只出现在“共同点”起源；“霸主”起源直接设置霸权联邦，没有窗口。联邦随后获得600经验与100凝聚力。
notes.en: Fired only for Common Ground; Hegemon sets hegemony_federation directly without a window. The federation then receives 600 experience and 100 cohesion (events/origin_events_1.txt:2108-2113).

uncertain: The origin-families.json "shared" entry that lists origin.57 for origin_hegemon is wrong: origin.57 is only fired inside the Common Ground branch (:1932). That key is not read by the compiler.
